results.clause_summary: Minimum clear cover for beams shall not be less than 25mm
results.violation_detail: Clear cover to main reinforcement is 18mm, which is below the minimum 25mm mandated by IS 456:26.5.1.1 for beams in moderate exposure.
results.ai_suggestion: Increase clear cover to 25mm minimum. Verify exposure condition — if severe, cover must be 45mm per Table 16.

results.clause_summary: Minimum longitudinal reinforcement in columns shall be 0.8% of gross cross-sectional area
results.violation_detail: Longitudinal reinforcement ratio is 0.72%, below the minimum 0.8% required by IS 456:26.5.3.1.
results.ai_suggestion: Add 2 nos. 12mm bars to bring reinforcement ratio above 0.8%.

results.clause_summary: Span-to-depth ratio for slabs shall not exceed 26 for simply supported spans
Columns in seismic zone III and above shall have special confining reinforcement
results.violation_detail: Column C-11 lacks special confining reinforcement in the plastic hinge region. This is mandatory for seismic zone III per IS 1893:7.1 read with IS 13920.
results.ai_suggestion: Provide confining hoops at 75mm c/c for a distance of 450mm from each joint face per IS 13920:7.4.
